item.description:
Aside 1.7.13

The notch opens like glass, the floating pill morphs into the card, and the transcript keeps up with the conversation.

Notch and panel

  • Glass material. The notch expands with a real glass look instead of a flat black block, and the open and close animation runs smoothly without a hard border around the card.
  • Floating mode morphs. On Macs without a notch, the pill morphs into the card and back, staying where it is instead of popping.
  • Transcript follows the last sentence. The live transcript scrolls with the conversation, so the newest line is always in view. The consent hint shows once at the start and then gets out of the way.

Audio

  • Switching input devices no longer drops the mic. Plugging in or removing a headset mid-call keeps the recording going.

Settings

  • The "Your name" field shows the detected name as a placeholder again instead of as a broken label.
  • Shorter explanation under "Buffer the last 5 minutes during calls", and the settings sidebar drops the redundant "Aside" heading.
